hypothesis.statement: swbos's DOMINANT residual is not the fusion but the LOCAL-AREA SLOT ASSIGNMENT: the target names 10 distinct frame slots where our build names 8, and the decisive words are the two projection-buffer addresses -- the target emits `addi r6,r1,84` (0x38c10054, T+0x0a8) for the first MBWindowProject call and `addi r6,r1,80` (0x38c10050, T+0x130) for the second, while our build emits the SAME word `addi r6,r1,32` (0x38c10020) at BOTH sites (O+0x0b0 and O+0x138). The target has two projection buffers; our source has one, reused. If a lane wants swbos, the source axis is the two-buffer split -- which attempt.CL_swbos-bottom-anchored-temp-group-blocks-every-declared-pad.20260902.v1 already reproduced in ARRANGEMENT (its probe 2 seated sp0 above sp1 exactly as the target does) but could not combine with a base fix. The two-buffer split is a SEPARATE fact from the 40-byte base displacement, and no record has yet held the base constant while varying only the buffer count.
